description: Election Commission - Declare that Mr. R. Ushanth and Mrs. K. Sothimalar as members of the Valikamam-South Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in a local government body (Valikamam South Pradeshiya Sabha) due to non-attendance of meetings and resignation, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of elected members to fill vacancies, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
